a.title: Timely and Accurate Payments by adopting reliable digital payroll systems (Goal)
Timely and Accurate Payments by adopting reliable digital payroll systems (Goal)
Proven Skills by ensuring health worker qualification (Goal)
Continuous Growth by enabling capacity building and fostering career development (Goal)

Ensure all health workers receive timely payments by adopting reliable digital payroll systems. This includes maintaining a health workforce registry to ensure qualification, retention, capacity building, and career development. (Goal)

text.tspan: Ensure all health workers receive timely payments by adopting reliable digital payroll systems. This includes maintaining a health workforce
registry to ensure qualification, retention, capacity building, and career development.
Digitally Enabled Health Workforce: "Timely Pay, Proven Skills, Continuous Growth"

g.text: Colour: which part of the architecture a box belongs to
Why: who cares (stakeholders), and the drivers, goals, outcomes, values and requirements
Shape: what kind of thing a box is (its small italic label names the exact kind)
Cut corners: a reason or aim, such as a stakeholder, goal, outcome or value
Note: a comment from the authors
Line: how two boxes are related, read from where the line starts to where it ends
Composition: is made up of (the end is a part that cannot exist without the start)
Association: is related to (no more specific meaning)
